people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: So the house of Israel will know that I am Yahweh their God, from that day and forward.
translations.bsb: From that day forward the house of Israel will know that I am the LORD their God.
translations.kjv: So the house of Israel shall know that I am the LORD their God from that day and forward.
translations.asv: So the house of Israel shall know that I am Jehovah their God, from that day and forward.
